keeper-sp-keepersoorlog.uitleg: Two keepers each stand in a goal, 18 m apart. They take turns trying to score against each other: throwing or kicking from hands, from inside their own goal area. Whoever catches the ball can go straight back. First to 5 goals wins.
keeper-sp-keepersoorlog.organisatie: Two (youth) goals facing each other 18 m apart. Shoot from no more than 4 m in front of your own goal. Throws, volleys and drop kicks all count; a caught ball may be played straight back.
benodigdheden: Disc cones for the shooting line
coachpunten: Straight back into the ready position after your throw: the ball can come straight back
Catch it where you can, otherwise punch or tip it
Choose wisely: low into the corner is often harder to save than hard and high

makkelijker: Smaller goals or a longer distance
moeilijker: The ball must go back within 3 seconds

keeper-sp-keepersoorlog.meerSpelers: With more keepers: whoever concedes swaps with a waiting keeper. Or play keeper wars on one goal.

keeper-sp-keepersvolleybal.uitleg: Two keepers play volleyball with their hands over a 2 m net. Throw the ball over the net into the other keeper's court; they must catch it before it hits the ground (diving allowed). If the ball lands in the court, it's a point.
keeper-sp-keepersvolleybal.organisatie: 8 × 14 m court with a net or tape at 2 m in the middle. Throw from where you caught the ball. Play to 11 points.
benodigdheden: Net or tape at 2 m with 2 posts
coachpunten: Throw to the empty space in the other keeper's court
Straight after your throw, get back to the middle of your court
Dive forwards, towards the ball
keeper-sp-keepersvolleybal.meerSpelers: With more keepers: 2v2 on a slightly bigger court, or winners stay on.

keeper-sp-keepersrondo.uitleg: A rondo for keepers. The outside keepers pass the ball round with their feet, the keeper in the middle tries to intercept it and may use their hands: diving, smothering or catching. Whoever loses the ball or whose pass is caught goes in the middle; the interceptor becomes an outside keeper.
keeper-sp-keepersrondo.organisatie: Smallest version: 3v1 in a triangle with 9 m sides (disc cones on the corners). With 3 keepers, the coach joins in as the third outside player. With 4 keepers: 3v1 without the coach or 4v1 in a 9 × 9 m square. With 7 keepers: 5v2 in a 12 × 12 m area.
coachpunten: Outside: control and look first, then pass cleanly along the ground onto the far foot
Middle: low in the ready position, cut off the passing lane, only dive once the ball is played
Swap quickly after an interception: whoever made the mistake goes straight in the middle

makkelijker: Outside keepers may take two touches
moeilijker: Smaller triangle (7 m): the middle keeper gets to the ball sooner
Ten passes in a row without losing it is a point

keeper-sp-keepersoorlog-een-goal.uitleg: One keeper stands in goal, the others queue on the edge of the box. The coach stands beside the goal and plays the ball in to the front keeper, who takes one touch and shoots, or shoots first time. The keeper in goal tries to save it. With three or more keepers, swap after every go: the shooter goes in goal, the keeper joins the back of the queue.
keeper-sp-keepersoorlog-een-goal.organisatie: Full-size goal. Queue of keepers on the edge of the box (16 m), straight in front of goal. Coach with balls beside the far post, about 2 m from the goal. At least 2 keepers: then they take turns to shoot from the edge of the box and swap places after every go. With 3 or more keepers: swap as in the animation. A save is a point; so is a goal.
coachpunten: As the shooter: first touch out in front of you, a quick look at the keeper and shoot low into the corner
In goal: get set as the shooter plants their standing foot, only then dive
After a save, ball straight back to the coach and swap quickly: keep the tempo high

makkelijker: Only shoot after a first touch
moeilijker: The coach also plays it in the air: volley or header
Straight after the save, a second ball from the coach (rebound)

keeper-sp-vier-doeltjes.uitleg: Four small goals in a square. Two keepers each defend their own goal, opposite each other. A server stands by each of the other two goals. A server shoots at one of the keepers. If the keeper catches it, they counter straight away to the other side: throwing or kicking at the other keeper's goal. Catches and saves count; every goal is a point for the shooter. After a few minutes the keepers and servers swap roles.
keeper-sp-vier-doeltjes.organisatie: 22 × 22 m square with a 3 m goal in the middle of each side. Keepers in the north and south goals, servers by the east and west goals.
coachpunten: Small goal: stay just in front of your line, then everything is within reach
After the catch: look and play quickly, the other keeper isn't set yet
Counter firm and low, or with an arc if the keeper is well off their line

moeilijker: The servers also pass to each other before the shot

keeper-sp-twee-tegen-twee-twee-doelen.uitleg: Two goals facing each other, a keeper in each. Two coaches are the attackers: they combine and attack one of the goals together. After a save, the keeper sets up the next attack by throwing the ball to one of the coaches, who then attack the other goal. Which keeper concedes the fewest goals?
keeper-sp-twee-tegen-twee-twee-doelen.organisatie: Two goals about 30 m apart (or two small 5 m goals). Coaches with balls in the middle.
coachpunten: Shift with the ball, including when the attackers pass to each other
Get set as the shot is taken
After the save: build the next attack quickly and accurately, onto the coach's foot

makkelijker: The attackers may pass only once
moeilijker: Counter straight after the save (play it on immediately)

keeper-sp-een-op-een-competitie.uitleg: One keeper is in goal, the other keepers take turns as the attacker. The attacker passes to the coach, who returns it with a through ball into space. The attacker goes 1v1 at goal. After a round, the keeper who conceded the most goes back in goal.
keeper-sp-een-op-een-competitie.organisatie: Attackers with balls at 22 m, coach at 16 m. One keeper in goal.
coachpunten: Go as the through ball is played: that's the moment to gain ground
When the attacker has the ball at their feet: get set, small and wide, and block
As the attacker: keep the tempo up and make the keeper choose

makkelijker: The coach plays the ball to feet
The attacker must shoot within 5 seconds
moeilijker: Through balls in the air too
A second attacker sprints alongside for the cutback
A goal counts double after beating the keeper
